questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements."

**Statements:**

 
• Some plants are rocks.
 
• No vegetable is a plant.

**Conclusions:**

I. No vegetable is a rock.

II. Some rocks are plants.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83ae24a164bc3792063d5f0b5f68f1837d8a37292c286d49c10d2ddb3d304040.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No vegetable is a rock → **Does not **follow (As some plants are rocks and no vegetable is a plant. As no direct relation is given between vegetable and rocks, therefore it is false)

II. Some rocks are plants → Follow (As some plants are rocks. As some part of plants is common with rocks, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows. ​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: Seven people S, E, C, T, I, O and N are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). E is sitting second to the left of N, while N is sitting second to the left of S. Only one person is sitting between S and O when counted from the right of S. C is sitting to the immediate right of E, whereas T is sitting to the immediate left of O. Who is sitting to the immediate right of I?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven people S, E, C, T, I, O and N are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) E is sitting second to the left of N, while N is sitting second to the left of S.

2) Only one person is sitting between S and O when counted from the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7cfa8c3c13d6183dac5df73e5a6978b456ecd060809dcbca0faf0d200b4ef68.png] 

3) C is sitting to the immediate right of E, whereas T is sitting to the immediate left of O. 

After positioning C and T only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfa3db29206cffc09d71407abd5b3a9aade243f1c4cad5da952299ff45508df6.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, S is sitting to the immediate right of I.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement(s) is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All pumpkin is mutton.

All mutton are fishes.

Conclusions:

(I) Some fishes are mutton.

(II) All pumpkins are fishes.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/756c6339ebe0251894598927f805d68a653510ce30697c5b589b4712531b9dc0.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some fishes are mutton → Follow (As all pumpkin is mutton and all mutton are fishes. As whole mutton comes in fishes, therefore it is true)

(II) All pumpkins are fishes → Follow (As all pumpkin is mutton and all mutton are fishes. As whole pumpkin comes in mutton which whole comes in fishes, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

Only 3 people are sitting between E and A when counted from the right of E. B is sitting 2nd to the left of A. G is sitting to the immediate left of F. Only 2 people are sitting between B and G when counted from the right of B. C is the immediate neighbour of E. What is the position of D with respect to E?
questions.solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Only 3 people are sitting between E and A when counted from the right of E.

2) B is sitting 2nd to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca0ef0c600ca55ee0369d167db216f901ba64ed4df323ebff17d1b63067d4205.png] 

3) Only 2 people are sitting between B and G when counted from the right of B.

4) G is sitting to the immediate left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7399d2f0f390c6f3f98f324bb151a44daf45e5cd597527afb7ce0d23f04963c.png] 

5) C is the immediate neighbour of E. 

After positioning C only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c738e8a5f7a622ababe93c7e3716ab88c34e56b8893de97a5e406a6f316c8c5.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, D is 3rd from the right of E.

Hence, **"Option 1" **is the correct answer.
